blocks.text: Boquete: canopy tour and coffee plantation

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Depart Boca Chica at 07:30 and transfer to Boquete. The drive takes about 1.5 hours.

The canopy tour begins at 10:30. The route follows cables and platforms above the jungle and a mountain river. Four to five instructors assist participants on the platforms. The stretches between the last four platforms are particularly long. Along the way, you can see the forest, river and waterfalls.

At 13:00, visit a coffee plantation for a tasting, including Geisha, one of Panama's most expensive export coffee varieties.

After the tour, transfer to the hotel.
